title: Compute volume thermal expansion
action: Read observed linear expansion data (Y_a, Y_b, Y_c) from observed_data.csv, compute volume expansion Y_v = (1+Y_a)*(1+Y_b)*(1+Y_c)-1 for each temperature, and write the result to volume_expansion.csv.
description: Intermediate volume expansion derived from linear expansion data, required for the subsequent model fitting.

title: Fit thermal expansion models and compute Grüneisen parameter
action: Fit the Wachtman-type thermal expansion models (a form using Debye thermal energy E(θ, T)) to the observed linear (Y_a, Y_b, Y_c) and derived volume (Y_v) data. Determine parameters Q0, θ, k, a_minus_1 for each axis and volume via least-squares. Compute Grüneisen parameter γ = B0*V0 / Q0 using the volume Q0 and B0*V0 = 6.28e6 J/mol. Output all fitted parameters and γ to fitted_parameters.json.
description: Fitted parameters from thermal expansion model and derived Grüneisen parameter.
